pages.title: Animal Crossing Raymond Smiling in His Signature Waistcoat and Glasses Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing's Raymond smiling in his signature waistcoat and glasses, with a necktie, swept fringe, and one raised paw.
